headline: Northern Michigan overtake Roosevelt as top scorers
dek: Luca Rosen has scored eight of Northern Michigan's fifteen goals from twenty-two shots, and no other programme has scored as many. Two defeats keep them behind Roosevelt, Purdue Northwest and Saginaw Valley State, the sides yet to lose.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring most no longer means losing least: Northern Michigan's fifteen goals, from six different scorers, sit beside ten conceded, more than any unbeaten side has let in.

wire.line: Luca Rosen has eight goals for Northern Michigan, more than half of everything the side has scored.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Nine matches whose dates have passed carry no published result, the earliest of them Northern Michigan's opening match against Green Bay.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Davenport's win at Aquinas was their first of the season, after two defeats and two draws.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Estefano Alvear has saved eighteen shots and conceded three goals for Purdue Northwest, a save percentage of .857.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Roosevelt's four wins are more than any other programme has managed.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Andrés García has scored four of St. Cloud State's six goals, from thirteen shots, while the side has conceded twelve.

last_match.line: Northern Michigan have now scored more than any side in the conference; Luca Rosen leads every scorer in it.

next_match.line: The conference's opening match: Saginaw Valley State are yet to lose, and Davenport arrive with their first win of the season.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
